triage.note: S5 requirement 4: `.it .ttl` was `--dim` at the smallest declared size, so item titles ("Business", "Risk Factors") read as grey noise beside the amber item code. Watched red against the pre-fix file (`color:var(--dim)`, no `font-weight` declared at all), green once the rule read `color:var(--ink);font-weight:700`. Token-level only — the rendered ratio for the same rule is covered by ui-contrast-and-specificity's row-title/row-title-hover/row-title-selected pairs, re-grounded from `var(--dim)` to `var(--ink)` in the same diff; this check exists so a future edit that quietly repoints `.ttl` back at `--dim` or drops the weight goes red here even before a contrast run.
